test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 09 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select ‘No improvement’.**

__**Herbalism had become an all but extinct skill**__ in the Western world.

options.text: Herbalism has become but all an extinct skill
Herbalism has become but an extinct skill

solution:
Here the correct answer is **No improvement.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct answer is **option 1) No improvement.**
 
• The original sentence is grammatically correct and effectively conveys the intended meaning.
 
• The phrase** "all but" **is idiomatic and means **"almost" **or **"nearly." **It is used to emphasize that herbalism is extremely rare or close to being extinct in the Western world. The placement of "all but" before "extinct" is appropriate in this sentence.
 
• **Option 2) "Herbalism has become but all an extinct skill"** changes the word order and does not improve the sentence. It disrupts the natural flow of the sentence and sounds awkward.
 
• **Option 3) "Herbalism become an extinct skill"** omits the auxiliary verb "has" and is grammatically incorrect. The sentence requires the present perfect tense "has become" to indicate an action that started in the past and continues to the present.
 
• **Option 4) "Herbalism has become but an extinct skill"** rearranges the word order, but it is not necessary. The original sentence is already clear and concise.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1) No improvement,** as the original sentence is grammatically correct and effectively conveys the intended meaning.
